title: fix(export): customer names with commas break the CSV export
body: Support reported that exporting customers whose name contains a comma ("Acme, Inc.") shifts every later column in that row. csvField now quotes a field that contains a comma.

threads.author: review-bot[bot]
threads.body: toJson writes one object per line, but the export endpoint serves it as `customers.json`. Tools that expect a JSON document (jq without --slurp, Excel's JSON import) fail to parse it. Wrap the rows in an array.

threads.author: review-bot[bot]
threads.body: csvField wraps the value in quotes but does not escape quotes already inside it. A name like `Bob "Builder", Jr` produces `"Bob "Builder", Jr"`, which CSV readers still split into the wrong columns. Double any embedded quotes (RFC 4180).

threads.author: review-bot[bot]
threads.body: European Excel locales expect `;` as the CSV delimiter. Add a delimiter option to csvRow/toCsv so those users can open the export directly.

threads.author: review-bot[bot]
threads.body: xlsxDate has no tests. Add unit tests covering timezone edge cases around midnight UTC.

threads.author: maintainer-dana
threads.body: The TSV exporter has the same bug with tabs inside a name, and support will file it next week. Please fix it in this PR too so we ship one release note.

threads.author: review-bot[bot]
threads.body: Nit: rename the parameter `s` to `field` for readability.
